notes.title: Localised Version Now Available
notes.notes:
Hello Fellow Adventurers!
We have updated the build so it now features Russian, Spanish and Japanese subtitles.
We are currently finishing off the German translation and that should be available soon.
You need to restart the game and Steam will automatically update the game.

Thank you!
